title: Jannes Modpack
description: The best mods. Performance and helpful GUI mods.
body:
**The Modpack version 2.x is for my Server!!!**

This modpack contains all the mods and resource packs that I use (and a few others that I personally find very useful quality-of-life mods)! This modpack works perfectly fine in single-player mode. If you want to use it on a server, make sure it allows mods like Litematica, Freecam, or Clientsort. I am not responsible for any bans resulting from the use of these mods.
